environment.description: ECS Fargate service running the Terraform provider API. The task role has a broad DynamoDB policy: dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:DeleteItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem on the table ARN with no condition keys. The API Gateway passes X-Tenant-ID from JWT claims but the application code never uses it for authorization. Table partition key is 'resource_id' (string) with no composite key involving tenant_id.

config.network: Public ALB -> ECS Fargate, no additional authorization layer
